# appwrite_postgresql_backup (Action)

Takes an on-demand backup of a dedicated PostgreSQL database. Scheduled backups belong in appwrite_postgresql_backup_policy; this is for the backup you want taken right now, before a migration or a risky change.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) The ID of the database to back up.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.
- `type` (String) The backup type. Defaults to the server's own default.
